No significant differences in plasma AUC were observed between groups, indicating the effect is specific to brain exposure."
Reported evidence: Itraconazole (ITC) brain exposure was assessed in OF1 mice infected with C. neoformans after i.p. administration of 10 mg/kg ITC, with or without pretreatment with the P-gp inhibitor GF120918 (10 mg/kg i.p.). In infected mice, P-gp inhibition further increased ITC brain exposure, indicating that ITC is a substrate of P-gp at the BBB and that its brain penetration is limited by P-gp efflux.
